tools.name: core_list_projects
tools.description: Retrieve a list of projects in your Azure DevOps organization.

stateFilter.description: Filter projects by their state. Defaults to 'wellFormed'

top.description: The maximum number of projects to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.description: The number of projects to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.

continuationToken.description: Continuation token for pagination. Used to fetch the next set of results if available.

tools.name: core_list_project_teams
tools.description: Retrieve a list of teams for the specified Azure DevOps project.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project.

mine.description: If true, only return teams that the authenticated user is a member of. Defaults to true

top.description: The maximum number of teams to return. Defaults to 100.

skip.description: The number of teams to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: pipelines_definition
tools.description: Read operations on pipeline (build) definitions. 'list' returns a trimmed page of definitions ({ items, continuationToken }) with optional filters — pass continuationToken back with the same queryOrder to fetch the next page; 'list_revisions' returns the revision history for one definition. For 'list', repositoryId accepts a repository name or GUID — names are auto-resolved for Azure Repos.

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'list', 'list_revisions'.

project.description: Project ID or name. Required for both actions.

repositoryId.description: For 'list': Repository ID or name to filter build definitions. For Azure Repos (TfsGit), a repository name is auto-resolved to the GUID using the project parameter. For GitHub use OwnerName/Repository format and always pair with repositoryType.

repositoryType.description: For 'list': Required whenever repositoryId is set as a GUID or non-TfsGit format.

name.description: For 'list': Name of the build definition to filter.

path.description: For 'list': Path of the build definition to filter.

queryOrder.description: For 'list': Order in which build definitions are returned. Allowed values: None, LastModifiedAscending, LastModifiedDescending, DefinitionNameAscending, DefinitionNameDescending.

top.description: For 'list': Maximum number of build definitions to return.

continuationToken.description: For 'list': Token for continuing paged results. Must be paired with the same queryOrder used in the prior call.

minMetricsTimeInUtc.description: For 'list': Minimum metrics time to filter build definitions.

definitionIds.description: For 'list': Array of build definition IDs to filter. Must be a JSON array of integers, e.g. [123, 456].

builtAfter.description: For 'list': Return definitions that have builds after this date.

notBuiltAfter.description: For 'list': Return definitions that do not have builds after this date.

includeLatestBuilds.description: For 'list': Whether to include the latest builds for each definition.

taskIdFilter.description: For 'list': Task ID to filter build definitions.

processType.description: For 'list': Process type to filter build definitions.

yamlFilename.description: For 'list': YAML filename filter (e.g., 'azure-pipelines.yml'). Returns full property expansion implicitly - slightly heavier response.

definitionId.description: For 'list_revisions': ID of the build definition to get revisions for (> 0).

tools.name: pipelines_run
tools.description: Read operations on pipeline runs (Pipelines REST surface, distinct from classic builds). 'get' retrieves a single run; 'list' returns up to 10,000 runs for a pipeline (the Pipelines REST API does not support pagination on this endpoint — for pipelines with more runs, use pipelines_build action=list with a 'definitions' filter, which supports continuation tokens). Distinct from pipelines_write action=run_pipeline (which queues a new run); this tool is read-only.

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'get', 'list'.

project.description: Project ID or name. Required for both actions.

pipelineId.description: Numeric pipeline ID (> 0). This is the pipeline ID, distinct from a build definition ID - get it from pipelines_definition action=list's id field.

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search Azure DevOps Wiki for a given search text. Each result includes both the raw git filesystem 'path' and a 'pagePath' that is directly usable with the 'wiki' tool's 'get_page' action.

searchText.description: Keywords to search for wiki pages

includeFacets.description: Include facets in the search results

top.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: pipelines_build
tools.description: Read operations on Azure Pipelines builds. Use 'action' to choose: 'list' (search builds with filters or fetch by IDs; response is { items, continuationToken } — pass continuationToken back with the same queryOrder to fetch the next page), 'get_status' (status, issues, and report metadata for one build), 'get_changes' (commits/work-items associated with one build; also returns { items, continuationToken }). For 'list', repositoryId accepts a repository name or GUID — names are auto-resolved for Azure Repos. Discovery flow: core_list_projects -> pipelines_definition action=list -> this tool. Never invent project names or build IDs - look them up.

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'list', 'get_status', 'get_changes'.

project.description: Project ID or name. Must match a project the caller can access - call core_list_projects first if uncertain.

buildId.description: For 'get_status', 'get_changes': numeric build ID (> 0). Get from action=list - never pass 0/1/2 placeholders.

definitions.description: For 'list': Array of build definition IDs to filter builds.

queues.description: For 'list': Array of queue IDs to filter builds.

buildNumber.description: For 'list': Build number to filter builds.

minFinishTime.description: For 'list': Minimum finish time to filter builds.

maxFinishTime.description: For 'list': Maximum finish time to filter builds.

requestedFor.description: For 'list': User ID or name who requested the build.

reasonFilter.description: For 'list': Reason filter for the build (see BuildReason enum).

statusFilter.description: For 'list': Status filter. 'All' cannot combine with resultFilter; 'Completed' cannot combine with queryOrder=QueueTimeDescending.

resultFilter.description: For 'list': Result filter for the build (see BuildResult enum).

tagFilters.description: For 'list': Array of tags to filter builds.

properties.description: For 'list': Array of property names to include in the results.

top.description: For 'list': Maximum number of builds to return.

continuationToken.description: For 'list': Token for continuing paged results. Must be paired with the same queryOrder used in the prior call.

maxBuildsPerDefinition.description: For 'list': Maximum number of builds per definition.

deletedFilter.description: For 'list': Filter for deleted builds (see QueryDeletedOption enum).

queryOrder.description: For 'list': Order in which builds are returned.

branchName.description: For 'list': Branch name to filter builds.

buildIds.description: For 'list': Array of build IDs to retrieve. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with all other filter parameters (definitions, queues, branchName, statusFilter, resultFilter, tagFilters, ...). Must be a JSON array of integers, e.g. [123, 456].

repositoryId.description: For 'list': Repository ID or name to filter builds. For Azure Repos (TfsGit), a repository name is auto-resolved to the GUID using the project parameter. For GitHub use OwnerName/Repository format and always pair with repositoryType. NOTE: when a repository filter is supplied the underlying SDK overload does not support continuation tokens, so the response will contain a single page (continuationToken=null) regardless of 'top'.

repositoryType.description: For 'list': Required whenever repositoryId is set as a GUID or non-TfsGit format.

changesTop.description: For 'get_changes': Number of changes to retrieve, defaults to 100.

includeSourceChange.description: For 'get_changes': Whether to include source changes in the results, defaults to false.

tools.name: wit_backlog
tools.description: Read operations on Azure DevOps backlogs. Use 'action' to choose: 'list' (backlog levels for a team), 'list_work_items' (work items in a specific backlog level).

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'list', 'list_work_items'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Required for all actions.

team.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps team. Required for all actions.

backlogId.description: For 'list_work_items': The ID of the backlog category to retrieve work items from.

tools.name: search_workitem
tools.description: Get Azure DevOps Work Item search results for a given search text

searchText.description: Search text to find in work items

includeFacets.description: Include facets in the search results

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

continuationToken.description: Continuation token for pagination. Used to fetch the next set of results if available.

tools.name: pipelines_build_log
tools.description: Build log access. 'list' enumerates available logs for a build (returns log IDs, sizes, and types); 'get_content' fetches text for a single log by ID, optionally bounded by line range.

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'list', 'get_content'.

project.description: Project ID or name. Required for both actions.

buildId.description: Numeric build ID (> 0). Get from pipelines_build action=list.

logId.description: For 'get_content': numeric log ID. Get from action=list for the same buildId.

startLine.description: For 'get_content': Inclusive starting line number. Must be <= endLine. Leave both null to read from the start of the log; at most 5000 lines are returned per call, so page with startLine for long logs.

endLine.description: For 'get_content': Inclusive ending line number. Must be >= startLine.

tools.name: wiki
tools.description: Read operations on Azure DevOps wikis. Use 'action' to choose the operation: 'get_page' (retrieve a single page with metadata and optional content; supply EITHER 'url' OR 'wikiIdentifier' + 'project' + 'path'), 'list_pages' (list pages in a wiki; requires 'wikiIdentifier' + 'project'), 'list_wikis' (enumerate wikis for an organization or project; only 'orgName' is required, 'project' optional), 'get_wiki' (retrieve a single wiki by identifier; requires 'wikiIdentifier').

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'get_page', 'list_pages', 'list_wikis', 'get_wiki'.

project.description: The project name or ID. Required for 'list_pages', and for 'get_page' when 'url' is not provided. Optional for 'list_wikis' and 'get_wiki'.

wikiIdentifier.description: The unique identifier or name of the wiki. Required for 'list_pages' and 'get_wiki', and for 'get_page' when 'url' is not provided.

path.description: The path of the wiki page (e.g., '/Home' or '/Documentation/Setup'). Used by 'get_page'. Required for 'get_page' when 'url' is not provided.

url.description: The full URL of the wiki page. Used by 'get_page' as an alternative to supplying 'wikiIdentifier' + 'project' + 'path'.

includeContent.description: For 'get_page': when true, returns the page content alongside metadata. Defaults to true.

recursionLevel.description: For 'get_page': recursion level for subpages. 'None', 'OneLevel', or 'Full'.

top.description: For 'list_pages': the maximum number of pages to return. Range 1-100.

continuationToken.description: For 'list_pages': continuation token from a prior call.

pageViewsForDays.description: For 'list_pages': number of days to retrieve page view statistics for.

tools.name: wit_query
tools.description: Read operations on Azure DevOps work item queries. Use 'action' to choose: 'get' (a query by ID or path), 'get_results' (the results of a query by query ID), 'search' (search all queries accessible to the user by filter text), 'list' (list root query folders and their children for a project), 'wiql' (execute an ad-hoc WIQL query).

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'get', 'get_results', 'search', 'list', 'wiql'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Required for all actions.

query.description: For 'get': The ID or path of the query to retrieve.

id.description: For 'get_results': The ID (GUID) of the query to retrieve results for.

expand.description: For 'get', 'list' and 'search': Optional expand parameter for query details. Allowed values: 'None' (columns, links, changeInfo), 'Wiql' (adds WIQL text), 'Clauses' (adds WIQL clauses), 'All' (all properties), 'Minimal' (minimal properties and WIQL text).

depth.description: For 'get': How deep to expand the query. Defaults to 0. For 'list': Depth of children to fetch within query folders. Defaults to 1.

includeDeleted.description: For 'get', 'list' and 'search': Whether to include deleted items. Defaults to false.

useIsoDateFormat.description: For 'get': Whether to use ISO date format. Defaults to false.

team.description: For 'get_results' and 'wiql': The team name or ID. If not provided, the default team is used.

timePrecision.description: For 'get_results' and 'wiql': Whether to include time precision. Defaults to false.

top.description: For 'get_results' and 'wiql': Maximum number of results. Defaults to 50; for 'wiql', maximum is 1000. For 'search': Maximum number of queries to return. Defaults to 50, maximum is 200.

filter.description: For 'search': Required. The text to filter queries by name.

wiql.description: For 'wiql': The WIQL query string to execute, e.g., "SELECT [System.Id], [System.Title] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project".

tools.name: wit_work_item
tools.description: Read operations on Azure DevOps work items. Use 'action' to choose: 'get' (single work item by organization-unique ID; project is optional), 'get_batch' (multiple work items by IDs), 'list_comments' (comments on a work item), 'my' (work items relevant to the authenticated user), 'list_revisions' (revisions of a work item), 'list_for_iteration' (work items for a team iteration), 'get_type' (metadata for a work item type).

action.description: The operation to perform. One of: 'get', 'get_batch', 'list_comments', 'my', 'list_revisions', 'list_for_iteration', 'get_type'.

project.description: The name or ID of the Azure DevOps project. Optional for 'get', which retrieves by organization-unique work item ID when omitted. Required for all other actions.

id.description: For 'get': The ID of the work item to retrieve.

ids.description: For 'get_batch': The IDs of the work items to retrieve. Must be a nonempty JSON array of integers, e.g. [123, 456].

workItemId.description: For 'list_comments', 'list_revisions': The ID of the work item.

fields.description: For 'get', 'get_batch': Optional list of fields to include. For 'get' and 'get_batch', cannot be used together with the expand parameter.

asOf.description: For 'get': Optional date string to retrieve the work item as of a specific time.

expand.description: For 'get', 'get_batch', 'list_revisions': Expand options ('All', 'Fields', 'Links', 'None', 'Relations'). For 'get' and 'get_batch', cannot be used with fields.

top.description: For 'list_comments', 'list_revisions', 'my': Maximum number of results. For 'list_revisions', the supported range is 1-200.

skip.description: For 'list_revisions': Number of revisions to skip for pagination.

team.description: For 'list_for_iteration': The name or ID of the team. If not provided, the default team is used.

iterationId.description: For 'list_for_iteration': The ID of the iteration to retrieve work items for.

type.description: For 'my': The type of work items to retrieve.

includeCompleted.description: For 'my': Whether to include completed work items. Defaults to false.

workItemType.description: For 'get_type': The name of the work item type to retrieve.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search Azure DevOps Repositories for a given search text

searchText.description: Keywords to search for in code repositories

includeFacets.description: Include facets in the search results

top.description: Maximum number of results to return
